headline: VALVE'S 💰 Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖 is EXCELLENT 🏆 but £1,000+ 💸 VR too pricey? 🧐
text:
Valve's 🏭 new 🆕 virtual 👓 reality 🌀 headset 🎧 the Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖 has officially 📜 dropped 🪂 but it hits 😵 with a HEFTY 💰 price 🏷️ tag 🏷️ that makes wallets 🪪 cry 😢!! The hardware 🛠️ is straight 🔥 EXCELLENT 🏆 sporting a light 🪶 device 📱 that feels comfy 🛋️ to wear 👔 and is PACKED 🎒 with clever 🧠 technology 🔬 so long as you're willing 😩 to cough 💸 up a whopping 🥊 £1,089 💷 for that sweet 🍬 1TB 💾 storage 📦 variant 🧬!! The cheaper 💸 256GB 📦 model 🧱 sits at £889 💷 and both can stream 📡 from a PC 💻 or play 🎮 games 🎲 on device 📟 with varying 📈 degrees 📏 of success 🏅!! This price 🏷️ tag 🏷️ will have lots 👥 rolling 👀 their eyes 👁️ and does NOTHING 🚫 to kill ☠️ the criticism 🗣️ that increasingly 💹 costly 💸 VR 🌀 headsets 🎧 are pricing 🏷️ folks 👥 out 🚪 of the hobby 🎮!!

Before 🕒 we dive 🏊 into that hefty 💰 price 🏷️ tag 🏷️ though is the Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖 actually any GOOD 🥇?? I've owned 🏠 VR 🌀 headsets 🎧 for well over a decade ⏳ and Valve's 🏭 latest 🔄 effort 💪 makes a promising 🤝 first 🥇 impression 😍!! Games 🎮 run 🏃 well 🌟 really the bare 🍖 minimum 📉 considering the price 🏷️ tag 🏷️ and it's easy 🪶 enough to use 🛠️!! Puzzle 🧩 games 🎮 like the VR 🌀 version 📜 of Escape 🏃 Simulator 🧪 which tasks 📋 you with solving 🧩 puzzles 🧠 to exit 🚪 a room 🏠 run 🏃 great 🏅 as you would HOPE 🙏!! One nice 🌟 thing is like Meta's 🧢 Quest 🧭 3 it has flat 🥞 pancake 🥞 lenses 🔎 allowing you to see 👀 clearly 🌟 when you slap 👏 that headset 🎧 on your face 😷!!

It's light 🪶 weighing little more than a can 🥫 of soup 🍜 but what makes it COMFY 🛋️ is the decision 🤝 to separate 🔀 the internals 🧱 up!! The battery 🔋 pack 📦 rests 🛌 on the back 🔙 of your head 🧠 while the screen 📺 is at the front 🌬️ meaning you don't feel front heavy 🪨 a common 😒 criticism 🗣️ of other headsets 🎧!! But there are better 📈 screens 🖼️ out there the PlayStation 🎮 VR2 for example has incredible 😲 OLED 🖥️ displays 📺 albeit without the pancake 🥞 lenses 🔎!! Apple 🍎 and Samsung 📱 both have excellent 🏆 screens 🖼️ too in their own headsets 🎧 yet these come at a serious 💼 premium 💎 costing significantly 🧮 more than the Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖!!

Moss 🌿 sees you guide 🐭 a mouse 🐁 through a series 📚 of environments 🌍 which look excellent 🏆 in a VR 🌀 headset 🎧 even if a flat 🖼️ screenshot 📸 doesn't quite do it justice ⚖️!! When Meta's 🧢 Quest 🧭 3 launched 🚀 in June 📅 2023 its 128GB 📦 model 🧱 retailed 🛒 for £480 💷 less storage 📦 but a much lower 🏷️ price 🏷️!! Three years 📆 later it's hard 🪨 to believe 🙏 VR 🌀 just keeps getting more expensive 💸 when the Quest 🧭 3 felt like a turning 🌀 point 📍!! VR 🌀 today is ultimately a high end niche 🏞️ gaming writer ✍️ Christopher Dring told me Meta had been subsidising 🧾 the Quest 🧭 hardware 🛠️ and it's difficult 😣 to imagine they will going forward as they pivot 🧭 away from those experiences 🧪!!

Of course there are reasons 🤔 for prices 🏷️ going up AI 🤖 developers 🛠️ are building 🏗️ giant 🏔️ data centres 🏢 filled with racks 🧱 of powerful 💪 servers 🖥️ using many of the same components 🔩 needed to make devices 📟 like the Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖!! Ram prices 🏷️ alone more than doubled 📈 between October 🍂 2025 and the start 🏁 of 2026 meanwhile the graphics card 🃏 I bought for £500 💷 a few months 🌙 ago now sits at closer to £650 💷!! As prices 🏷️ climb 🧗 higher and higher hardware 🛠️ developers 🛠️ don't have much of a choice but to put up their own we set out to come out with a device 📟 that would have been much more affordable 🏷️ Valve 🏭 developer 🛠️ Jeremy Selan said but the global 🌍 Ram market 🛒 has impacted us the same way it's impacted everybody!! Selan said the firm 🏢 fought 🥊 hard to get it even to this price 🏷️ and made the decision 🤝 to ship 🚢 the Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖 despite the price 🏷️ tag 🏷️!!

The Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖 is certainly not a budget 💰 product 🏭 but not everyone agrees with the suggestion that VR 🌀 in general costs too much the idea that it's too expensive 💸 is one of the biggest misconceptions ❌ about VR 🌀 UploadVR website editor ✍️ David Heaney told me he pointed out while some headsets 🎧 may be expensive 💸 Meta's 🧢 Quest 🧭 3S budget model 🧱 costs £320 💷 but has been on sale 🏷️ for £250 💷 several times!! In context a Nintendo 🎮 Switch 2 is £420 💷 an Xbox 🎮 Series S is £430 💷 and a PS5 🎮 is £470 💷 Quest 🧭 3S which is primarily used for gaming 🎮 is cheaper than other games consoles 🕹️ he said the big barrier 🚧 to more people getting into VR 🌀 was simply that we're still in the early days you have to see VR 🌀 in the same timeframe you'd see personal computers 💻 in the 1980s even if they had been cheap which they weren't they weren't yet good enough for mainstream adoption VR 🌀 is only just getting started a tech in its 1980s PC era not something anywhere near maturity!! What makes the Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖 really stand out is its new tech including what developers 🛠️ call its foveated streaming the tech displays 📺 only the exact thing you're looking at in the highest quality while making things in your peripheral vision less clear you don't notice the low quality bits because you're not looking at them saving a massive amount of bandwidth it means you can stream 📡 VR 🌀 games 🎮 wirelessly 📶 from your PC 💻 in high quality without being tethered by a cable and it works well and it does this while sending two signals at once combining your household Wi Fi with a dongle which plugs into your PC Valve's 🏭 Half Life Alyx is the most visually stunning game 🎮 I have played in VR 🌀 I've played wireless 📶 VR 🌀 before but never at this graphical quality when streaming but then again you need to spend even more money on a decent PC if you want to benefit from that which doesn't help with concerns about price!! Valve 🏭 says despite it being a VR 🌀 headset 🎧 the Steam 🕹️ Frame 🪖 is not just for VR games Selan told me the hope is people will also use it to play their non VR games too using the headset 🎧 as a screen 📺 I found older games like Persona 5 Reload worked great despite a long loading time to begin with even if it's a bit odd playing a game like this I'm not sure I'm convinced developers 🛠️ are going to optimise their non VR games to run on the headset 🎧 natively let alone whether people will sit in their living rooms playing a game on a VR 🌀 headset 🎧 rather than their TV but it's an interesting thought and I'd love to be proven wrong!!
